description: Kanguru Defender 256 is a USB Flash Drive with 256-bit AES CBC Hardware encryption. All data on the device is 100% encrypted. Additionally supports secure hashing (SHA-1, SHA-256), random number generation (ANSI X9.31-AES), digital signatures (RSA-PKCS#1_V1.5), and may be managed through Kanguru's Central Management Console via an encrypted tunnel. Processor collection includes part numbers KN5111 and KN5111A.
